Idfc First Bank has appointed Chaitali Mehendale as Vice President, Content & Creative Lead.
Mehendale joins the bank following a seven-year stint at PharmEasy, where she most recently served as Senior General Manager – Marketing.
With experience spanning content marketing and communications, Mehendale has worked across sectors including BFSI, travel and healthcare.
